The '''Nishr Resistance''' was a local rebel force based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Nishr]]. Made up of the local [[Nish]] who wished to oppose the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] subjugation of their world, the resistance was allied with the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance's]] [[Nishr Taskforce]], who were operating on the planet. The resistance and the Nishr Taskforce would together to harass Imperial forces, including the elimination of most of the Imperial garrison's mobile elements in a coordinated ambush.
